build.buildCommand: cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../backend && rm -rf static_build && mkdir -p static_build && cp -r ../frontend/dist/. static_build/ && pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

deploy.startCommand: python manage.py migrate --noinput && gunicorn config.wsgi --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 2 --threads 4 --timeout 120 -k gthread
